changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Censo de usuarios (ARC-110): identidad, rol vigente, estado de cuenta, auditoria y retencion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE usuario ( user_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, full_name VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) NOT NULL, corporate_email VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) NOT NULL, role_code VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) DEFAULT 'ACTIVO' NOT NULL, is_active GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVO' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) VIRTUAL, role_changed_at TIMESTAMP(6), role_changed_by NUMBER, last_login_at TIMESTAMP(6), deactivated_at TIMESTAMP(6), deactivated_by NUMBER, deactivation_reason_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR), deactivation_note VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), retention_until DATE GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(deactivated_at + INTERVAL '24' MONTH AS DATE)) VIRTUAL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, created_by NUMBER, updated_at TIMESTAMP(6), updated_by NUMBER, CONSTRAINT pk_usuario PRIMARY KEY (user_id), CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_full_name_len CHECK (LENGTH(TRIM(full_name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 120), CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVO','INACTIVO')), CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_created_by_self CHECK (created_by <> user_id), CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_deactivated_by_self CHECK (deactivated_by <> user_id), CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_coherencia_baja CHECK ( (status = 'INACTIVO' AND deactivated_at IS NOT NULL AND deactivated_by IS NOT NULL AND deactivation_reason_code IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'ACTIVO' AND deactivated_at IS NULL AND deactivated_by IS NULL AND deactivation_reason_code IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_role_code FOREIGN KEY (role_code) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_deactivation_reason FOREIGN KEY (deactivation_reason_code) REFERENCES cat_motivo_desactivacion (reason_code), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_created_by FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_updated_by FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_role_changed_by FOREIGN KEY (role_changed_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_deactivated_by FOREIGN KEY (deactivated_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )
